title: Perceptions of Discriminatory Decisions of Artificial Intelligence: Unpacking the Role of Individual Characteristics
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It investigates human perceptions of AI decisions exhibiting gender and racial bias.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was outside the scope of its investigation into gender and racial bias perceptions.
